title: Global Mofy Reports 49.4% Revenue Growth as AI Digital Asset Business Expands

content_html:
Fiona Craig

Wed, July 29, 2026 at 7:31 AM PDT 3 min read

Strong top-line growth was driven by virtual technology services and a new AI digital asset sales business, although higher investment and asset impairment resulted in a GAAP net loss.

Key Investor Takeaways

  • Global Mofy (NASDAQ:GMM) reported revenue growth of 49.4% to $39.9 million for the six months ended March 31, 2026.

  • The company's new AI digital asset sales business and growing demand for virtual technology services were the primary growth drivers.

  • R&D spending more than doubled to $14.4 million as Global Mofy expanded its Gauss AI Lab and AI platform capabilities.

  • Despite strong revenue growth, higher operating costs, asset impairment, and increased investment led to a GAAP net loss of $50.7 million.

  • Management continues to position the company as a supplier of AI training data and generative AI content infrastructure.

Why GMM Stock Is in Focus

Global Mofy (NASDAQ:GMM) reported first-half fiscal 2026 revenue of $39.9 million, up 49.4% from $26.7 million a year earlier, as demand for its virtual production services and AI-driven digital assets continued to grow.

The company attributed the increase to strong adoption of its generative AI solutions, expanding virtual technology services, and the launch of a new business selling standardized 3D digital assets to large AI model developers.

However, profitability moved sharply lower. Cost of revenue increased 110.5% to $31.4 million, reducing gross profit to $8.5 million from $11.8 million in the prior-year period. Global Mofy reported an operating loss of $50.7 million, compared with operating income of $1.7 million a year earlier, primarily due to asset impairment, higher research and development spending, and increased share-based compensation.

GAAP net loss totaled $50.7 million, compared with net income of $5.0 million in the prior-year period. On a non-GAAP basis, which excludes items such as asset impairment, stock-based compensation, and warrant fair value changes, the company reported net income of $1.1 million.

Why This Matters for Investors

The results highlight the trade-off between rapid growth and profitability as Global Mofy accelerates investment in its AI strategy. Revenue growth suggests demand for the company's virtual production services and AI digital assets continues to strengthen, while the launch of its digital asset sales business expands its exposure to the growing AI training data market.

At the same time, the sharp increase in operating expenses and the significant asset impairment weighed heavily on reported earnings, resulting in a substantial GAAP loss despite higher sales. Investors may focus on whether the company's elevated research and development spending translates into sustainable revenue growth and improved operating leverage over time.

尽管投资和资产减值增加导致了 GAAP 净亏损，但虚拟技术服务和新的人工智能数字资产销售业务推动了营收的强劲增长。

主要投资者要点

  • Global Mofy（纳斯达克股票代码：GMM）报告称，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的六个月收入增长了 49.4%，达到 3,990 万美元。
  • 公司新的AI数字资产销售业务和对虚拟技术服务不断增长的需求是主要增长动力。
  • 随着 Global Mofy 扩大其 Gauss AI 实验室和 AI 平台能力，研发支出增加了一倍多，达到 1,440 万美元。
  • 尽管收入增长强劲，但运营成本上升、资产减值和投资增加导致 GAAP 净亏损 5,070 万美元。
  • 管理层继续将公司定位为人工智能培训数据和生成人工智能内容基础设施的供应商。

为什么 GMM 股票成为焦点

Global Mofy（纳斯达克股票代码：GMM）报告称，由于对其虚拟制作服务和人工智能驱动的数字资产的需求持续增长，2026 财年上半年收入为 3990 万美元，比上年同期的 2670 万美元增长 49.4%。

该公司将这一增长归因于其生成式人工智能解决方案的大力采用、扩大虚拟技术服务，以及推出向大型人工智能模型开发商销售标准化 3D 数字资产的新业务。

然而，盈利能力急剧下降。 收入成本增加 110.5%，达到 3140 万美元，毛利润从上年同期的 1180 万美元减少到 850 万美元。 Global Mofy 报告运营亏损 5070 万美元，而上年同期运营收入为 170 万美元，主要是由于资产减值、研发支出增加以及股权激励增加。

GAAP 净亏损总计 5070 万美元，而上年同期净利润为 500 万美元。 根据非公认会计原则（不包括资产减值、股票补偿和认股权证公允价值变动等项目），该公司报告净利润为 110 万美元。

为什么这对投资者很重要

随着 Global Mofy 加速对其人工智能战略的投资，结果凸显了快速增长和盈利能力之间的权衡。 收入增长表明对该公司虚拟制作服务和人工智能数字资产的需求持续增强，而其数字资产销售业务的推出扩大了其在不断增长的人工智能训练数据市场的敞口。

与此同时，营业费用的急剧增加和重大的资产减值严重影响了报告的收益，导致尽管销售额增加，但公认会计原则却出现了大幅亏损。 投资者可能会关注该公司增加的研发支出是否会随着时间的推移转化为可持续的收入增长和运营杠杆的提高。
